title: Inaugural Ceremony of 4th National Pharmacovigilance Week 2024
bodyHtml:
4th National Pharmacovigilance Week 2024

The 4th National Pharmacovigilance Week 2024 inaugurated on 17th September, 2024 in the presence of: Dr Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi (Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, IPC & Drugs Controller General of India), Prof Y.K Gupta (National Scientific Advisor - PvPI), Dr Sunil Singhal (Member, Central Council, IMA - Head Quarter), Dr Rajendra P Joshi (Additional Medical Superintendent

Lady Hardinge Medical College & Hospital, New Delhi), Shri Bikas R Mahto (Under Secretary, MoHFW, GoI), Dr Jai Prakash (Officer-in-Charge, PvPI) along with Pharma Industry Representatives and other Stakeholders.

?️ Date: 17.09.2024 ? Venue: Iyer Hall, IPC ? Theme: Building ADR Reporting Culture for Patient Safety.

NCC-PvPI released following at the Inaugural Ceremony of 4th National Pharmacovigilance Week 2024

1. Promotional Materials

  • - PV Comic (Endgame of Side Effects)
  • - PvPI Quarterly Newsletter (Volume 14 Issue 2)
  • - PvPI Posters

2. Pharmacovigilance Guidance Document for Market Authorization Holders (MAHs) of Pharmaceutical Products (Version 2.0)

3. Quality Manual of PvPI
